channel.title: AI Frontier Post
channel.description: Dispatches from the AI frontier: AI news, research explainers, frontier lab coverage, and product comparisons.

item.title: Claude Opus 5.5 made a one-minute 3D movie by writing Blender code — in 8 hours on an RTX 5090
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: A Reddit creator handed Claude Opus 5.5 one prompt and a mascot image. What came back was not a generated video but a Blender render built from code — a nine-shot short that took about eight hours on a single RTX 5090, and a thread full of people arguing about what it proves.

item.title: iOS 27.2 gives Siri AI a memory: conversation recall, five new languages, and an Excluded Apps control
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: Apple’s October 26 update lets Siri AI remember past conversations, draw on photos, voicemails and calendar invites, and speak five new languages — while a new Excluded Apps control lets you fence off the apps it may not touch.

item.title: Atlas Bio emerges from stealth with $12.5M to replace Phase II trials with AI virtual patients
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Swiss startup Atlas Bio has emerged from stealth with $12.5 million to run drug trials on AI virtual patients — 12-week simulations trained on about two million human RNA readouts, aimed at the costliest bottleneck in drug development.

item.title: Percepto opens its inspection AI to any drone: Axion brings 160 models to power grids, oil rigs, and factories
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Percepto launched Axion on October 27, 2026: a hardware-agnostic Physical AI platform, sold as software-as-a-service, that applies more than 160 AI models to inspection data from any drone fleet or sensor network — so power, oil and gas, and industrial operators can act on problems before they escalate.

item.title: Run a full SEO audit from your terminal: hands-on with Claude SEO, the 22,000-star Claude Code plugin
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Claude SEO is a free, MIT-licensed plugin for Claude Code: 26 skills and 19 agents that audit any website and return a prioritised action plan. This guide installs v2.5.0, sets up its isolated runtime, and verifies its tools — with the full agent audit’s limits stated plainly.

item.title: Opera brings local AI to its browsers: WebAI runs open models on your laptop — no subscription, no data leaving the device
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Opera began shipping local AI models in its browsers on October 27, 2026: WebAI, an opt-in early preview in Opera One, lets websites and extensions use open models running on the user’s own computer — starting with Google’s Gemma and, on Macs, Apple’s on-device foundation model.

item.title: Listen Labs launches Listen Twins: AI models of real customers that predict what they'll do — and show the quote behind every answer
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Listen Labs' new Listen Twins are one-to-one AI models built from in-depth interviews with real people; a panel of 100 or more answers in seconds, each answer traced to its reasoning, quote, and confidence score.

item.title: Microsoft offers voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees as AI spending climbs to $175B
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: Microsoft is offering voluntary exits to about 60,000 employees — roughly 27% of its workforce — as it holds down labour costs while funding a $175B AI infrastructure buildout. Decisions are due by early December, with departures at year-end.

item.title: Stop shipping AI slop: hands-on with Hallmark, the design skill that refuses to look AI-made
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: Hallmark (Nutlope/hallmark, 38,038 GitHub stars) is a design skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode that refuses to look AI-generated: 48 themes, a hard floor of design rules, and a linter that grades your page. This guide installs it, deals a theme, and runs its own linter on a deliberately sloppy page until it passes clean.

item.title: Map everything attackers can see about your company: a hands-on guide to CVEngine
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: CVEngine (hevnsnt/CVEngine, GPL-3.0, 404 GitHub stars) is a free, self-hosted platform that maps your internet-facing assets, matches today's exploited CVEs against what you actually run, and hands you a verdict instead of a pile of alerts. This guide installs it with one command, adds your first authorized target, and walks the pipeline from discovery to a validated finding — plus the API and MCP hooks that let your coding agent work the same inventory.

item.title: Giotto launches Solo and Alto: Swiss sovereign AI that runs on one GPU — or eight B300s
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Giotto's Solo runs on a single GPU and its flagship Alto on eight B300s, and both are built to run anywhere in Europe with no US cloud dependency — shared cloud access is free.

item.title: Run open models on your own machine: the complete Ollama hands-on guide
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Ollama turns your own computer into a private AI server: one binary, one command per model, and a local API your apps can call. This guide installs Ollama v0.40.11, runs a real model on CPU, customizes it with a Modelfile, and wires it into code through the REST and OpenAI-compatible APIs — every command run, every output shown.

item.title: Akamai turns its edge cloud into a full AI stack: managed inference, an agent sandbox, and Blackwell Ultra GPUs
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Akamai introduced Akamai Inference and Akamai Agent Sandbox on October 27, 2026, adding managed model serving and isolated agent execution to Akamai Cloud — alongside Blackwell Ultra GPU clusters — with both products in beta.

item.title: A tiny 4B model is learning to code 3D scenes — on a single GPU, with the full release due tomorrow
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: A hobbyist fine-tune of Qwen3.5-4B is learning to write Three.js scenes that run on the first try, checkpoint by checkpoint, in public — and its creator says the full weights, dataset, and evaluation report land tomorrow.

item.title: Naver signs its $9B Brookfield AI infrastructure deal, clearing the way for Nvidia's $1B stake
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Naver signed a computing-infrastructure contract with Brookfield on October 27, worth up to $9 billion by 2028 — meeting the condition for Nvidia's planned $1 billion investment and moving its sovereign AI factory project into full execution.

item.title: Anthropic's public S-1 puts the SpaceX compute deal at $120.5B, not $84.5B
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: Anthropic's public IPO filing says it will spend up to $120.5 billion on SpaceX compute through 2029 — about $36 billion more than the confidential-prospectus figure reported in September. The catch: either side can walk away on 90 days' notice after early 2027.

item.title: noyb files five GDPR complaints against Scale AI over Outlier worker surveillance
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: European privacy group noyb filed five GDPR complaints against Scale AI on October 27, 2026, alleging its Outlier platform subjects more than 900,000 freelance data workers to invasive tracking, forced biometric checks and unanswered data-access requests.

item.title: Stop letting your coding agent grep: hands-on with XERJ, the local search engine for AI agents
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: XERJ (xerj-org/xerj) is a single Rust binary that turns any folder into a local search engine for coding agents: index a project once, then get cited passages instead of whole files. This guide installs v1.0.0-rc.99, indexes a demo shop, and verifies search, go-to-definition, the Elasticsearch API, reference coding, and the MCP server — every command run, every output shown.

item.title: Lotte launches its first AI hiring contest: build an agent for one of seven affiliates, with OpenAI judging
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Lotte Group announced on October 27, 2026 its first group-wide AI competition tied to hiring: the AX Challenge 2026. Entrants pick one of seven real tasks from Lotte affiliates, with preliminary applications open October 28 to November 4, a final in Osan on November 24-25, and seven winners sharing 20 million won plus a path to an internship.

item.title: Lette raises $6.5M to put AI agents to work on UK rentals — 60% of resident requests already automated
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: London-based Lette has raised a $6.5 million seed round led by Peak to scale its AI operating system for rental operators, which it says already handles over 60% of resident support and maintenance requests across some 30,000 units.

item.title: Singapore's SWITCH 2026 AI push: 24 'Champions of AI', S$150M for AI materials discovery, and agentic AI for small business
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: At SWITCH 2026, Singapore named the first 24 companies in its Champions of AI programme, put S$150 million behind an AI-led materials discovery platform, and pushed agentic AI workshops for small firms — a coordinated bid to turn AI pilots into economy-wide productivity.

item.title: Let your agent improve its own playbook: hands-on with Google Research's Harness²
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: Google Research's Harness² (20,269 stars) improves an agent's harness — prompts, tools, memory, guardrails and scripts — without retraining the model. This guide runs its no-credentials local demo end to end, reads the adopted harness and the lesson it stored, and maps the paid benchmark path.

item.title: Turn any website into RAG-ready Markdown: hands-on with PageSift
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: PageSift (YOLOW92/pagesift, AGPL-3.0, 111 GitHub stars) is a Rust web-crawling and extraction engine that turns websites, PDFs and Office files into clean Markdown for LLM pipelines, with Firecrawl- and Jina-compatible APIs. This guide runs it in Docker, scrapes a page two ways, crawls a small site, and wires it into Python and Claude Code — no hosted account required.

item.title: Omnichat raises $10M to turn chat apps into AI sales teams — 300 brands joined its analyst agent in two months
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Omnichat has raised a $10 million Series A to scale its Omni AI Agents across chat apps, after its OmniClaw analyst agent was taken up by around 300 brands within two months of its June launch.

item.title: A Claude-built mod turns Valheim into a city builder — press F7 and your Vikings start paying taxes
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: Press F7 and Valheim becomes a city builder: settlers move in, pay taxes, and demand mead. The free mod, largely coded by Claude, has r/ClaudeAI debating what AI-assisted modding means for the people who maintain it.
